c0006: Equivalent covers per day, year-1 average: about 47 dine-in (patio included from April through October) and about 15 from take-out and delivery, which are the orders (about 10 a day at about $52 excl. sales tax: 2 pizzas, a starter and a drink) divided by the average check. c0369: Year-round: dining room, beer & wine bar, register and reservations
c0371: Dinner and weekend shifts, when the dining room fills. Part-time W-2 employees; tips are not modeled
c0373: Dining room and patio in season, the pickup counter and the delivery marketplace tablets. c0389: Hours the shop is open to the public, adding lunch and dinner service and the preparation for each. The slow afternoon between the two is not counted

c0393: Dough, sauce and mise en place before opening, and lighting the oven, which takes an hour and a half to two hours to reach temperature
c0395: The owner with the prep & dough cook. Closing, cleaning and purchasing are outside this schedule: they are the margin between the hours hired and the hours needed
